Record Class ChaosEffect.FinalizerBacklogEffect

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.api.ChaosEffect.FinalizerBacklogEffect
Record Components:
objectCount - number of finalizable objects to allocate; must be > 0
finalizerDelay - delay each finalizer sleeps before completing; must be >= 0
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChaosEffect
Enclosing interface:
ChaosEffect
public static record ChaosEffect.FinalizerBacklogEffect(int objectCount, Duration finalizerDelay) extends Record implements ChaosEffect
Creates objects with slow finalizers to back up the finalizer queue. Simulates finalizer starvation, which delays GC reclamation and can cause OOM.

finalizerDelay is the duration each finalizer sleeps before completing. A long delay combined with a high objectCount causes the finalizer thread to fall progressively further behind.

  • Field Details

    • MAX_OBJECT_COUNT

      public static final int MAX_OBJECT_COUNT
      Upper bound on objectCount. The stressor constructor allocates and retains every object simultaneously; a pathological value like Integer.MAX_VALUE would trigger OutOfMemoryError mid-loop, which unwinds through ScenarioController.start() and leaves the already-registered controller orphaned. Failing plan validation is far cheaper than explaining a partially-activated scenario.
